title: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal roles or portal access, to retrieve customer loyalty point balances without proper permission checks. Attackers can craft requests to access loyalty data of customers outside their authorized scope.
